title: Shopify–NetSuite Sync for Nutrition Brands: Map Flavors, Serving Sizes, and Bundle SKUs
summary: Map Shopify variant IDs to approved NetSuite items so flavor, tub size, serving count and bundle revision stay distinct through orders and returns.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Nutrition-brand two-way sync should identify the exact sold variant: flavor, package size, serving count, and bundle revision. Map Shopify variant IDs to approved NetSuite item representations, retaining those distinctions even when marketing names look similar. Product identity must be correct before an order or return can be reconciled.


Explore the complete[nutrition and supplements integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/nutrition-supplements) for the systems and processes around this guide.
